subject: SOURCE clause
notes: A multi-operand SOURCE clause containing an arithmetic-expression parenthesizes EVERY operand, the bare identifiers included - ENFORCED (COBOL2142), never inferred from the grammar's greedy shape, because operands are separated by nothing but a space and the greedy parse would silently pick one of the two readings. Recorded at 2002 and above because SR7 bites only on a multi-operand clause, which SR6 confines to a repeating entry and 13.15.4 GR3's repetition vehicles are 2002 introductions; at 85 the clause is refused for that reason first. kb/Work PB852.
